messages:
incident-bot: PAGING — elevated p95 latency on eu-west1 inference cluster (model: redwood-v2-small) detected at 11:02 UTC. Error rate stable. Affected route: inference-eu-west1-prod. @oncall please respond. :rotating_light:

marta: I'm on it, joining call. seeing p95 ~250-900ms across pods, a few tails hitting ~1.1s. Looks correlated to large embedding batches from a handful of customers.

jamie: I see CPU/queueing on shard r3. Suspect batching pileup + KV cache misses. Suggest temporary batching cap and enabling prefix cache.

priya: Routing option: send non-SLA traffic to quantized fallback while we stabilize. I'll prepare a quick rule.

marta: Action plan: 1) apply batching.max_tokens=8 on busy shards 2) enable prefix KV caching for hot keys 3) route non-enterprise to redwood-v2-small-quant fallback. Doing step 1 now.

incident-bot: Change submitted: batching.max_tokens=8 on r3. Rollout id: rollout-1767-03. Monitor for 2m.

jamie: After cap p95 dropped to ~420ms, p99 ~1.0s. Improvement but still above SLO for some tails.

priya: routing change command (will run if cap doesn't bring stable):
```
redwood-cli route update --cluster eu-west1 --filter "tier!=enterprise" --target redwood-v2-small-quant
```
I'll queue it and hold for +5m confirmation.

simon: Observability: added a custom trace for the long requests. Early traces show repeated attention kernel retries on 16k context. Might be a model/seq-length hot path.

marta: Draft status page update (please review):
"We are investigating elevated response times for the eu-west inference cluster affecting a subset of requests. Mitigations (batching cap and routing to a quantized fallback) are in progress. Some customers may experience degraded latency; no increased error rates detected. We will provide another update within 30 minutes."

statusbot: DRAFT saved to /incidents/1767777777/status-draft. Suggested severity: degraded performance.

support-bot: Notified #support-escalations with the draft and the recommended customer list (tier:standard, developer). Suggest sending proactive note to customers with >5000 req/day if p95 remains >400ms after 20m.

jamie: Handoff: I'll own monitoring for the next 30m. Marta, please add any specific rollback triggers. My checklist before handing off further:
 - watch p95 and p99 dashboards for inference-eu-west1-prod
 - confirm routing rollback plan (reverse the route update)
 - escalate to infra if CPU >85% for >10m or error rate >0.1%

marta: Added rollback trigger: if p99 >1.2s for 10m or error rate >0.2%, rollback batching cap and open infra ticket. Incident doc updated: https://redwood.internal/incident/1767777777

incident-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 20m. Paging cleared to jamie for monitoring.

jamie: ack, monitoring. :white_check_mark:
